cues.zh: 以及一种啃噬内心的恐惧——其实你并不值得。
cues.en: and a gnawing fear that you actually don't.

cues.zh: 对我而言，《独立游戏大电影》里最能说明问题的一幕，是Phil意识到
cues.en: For me the most telling scene of Indie Game: The Movie is when Phil realized

cues.zh: 他以为那篇关于Fez的文章非常受欢迎，
cues.en: that an article about Fez he thought had been very popular

cues.zh: 实际上却几乎无人问津，然后他一脸崩溃地问：
cues.en: had actually gone largely ignored, and, looking destroyed, he asked,

cues.zh: “我为什么这么在意？”
cues.en: "Why do I care so much?"

cues.zh: 我读到的他是一个从故意颠覆别人对他的期待中获得某种奇异快感的人，
cues.en: I read him as a guy who took a weird joy in fucking with people's expectations of him,

cues.zh: 但他心里其实清楚，自己在意别人怎么看他，
cues.en: but knew that he actually cared what people thought of him,

cues.zh: 在意被接纳，同时也在怀疑这是不是对自己很不好。
cues.en: cared about being accepted, and also wondered if that wasn't very bad for him.

cues.zh: 对Phil的这个印象有多大价值？
cues.en: What is this impression of Phil worth?

cues.zh: 毫无价值。
cues.en: Nothing.

cues.zh: 我对Phil的所有了解都是间接的，来自互联网。
cues.en: Everything I know about Phil comes indirectly, from the internet.

cues.zh: 我和所有人能接触到的信息是一样的，
cues.en: I have access to the same set of information as everyone else,

cues.zh: 但我们得出的结论却千差万别。
cues.en: and we all draw wildly different conclusions.

cues.zh: 我们在Phil身上投射了不同的东西，这更多说明了我们自己，而非他。
cues.en: We project different things on Phil, which says more about us than it does about him.

cues.zh: 我不会说Phil不是个混蛋。
cues.en: I will not say that Phil isn't an asshole.

cues.zh: 我只想说，我们都不了解他。而这对你来说之所以重要，是因为
cues.en: I will only say that none of us know him. And why this matters to you is

cues.zh: 如果你正在看这个视频，那你就在互联网上。
cues.en: because if you're watching this, you are on the internet.

cues.zh: 在互联网上，能否接触到媒体之间并没有明确的界线，
cues.en: On the internet, there is no hard line between those who do and don't have access to the media,

cues.zh: 因为互联网本身就是媒体接触。
cues.en: because the internet is media access.

cues.zh: 在出名和不出名之间，存在着一个宽泛而模糊的渐变区间。
cues.en: There is a wide, fuzzy gradient between the famous and the unfamous.

cues.zh: 那个猫视频有2000次观看的人，比视频只有15次观看的人稍微出名一点。
cues.en: The person whose cat video has 2,000 views is slightly more famous than the person whose video has 15

cues.zh: 人们可以因为Wordpress而出名，因为Tumblr而出名，因为Facebook而出名。
cues.en: People can be Wordpress famous, Tumblr famous, Facebook famous.

cues.zh: 人们可以投身事业20年，然后突然之间非常迅速地出名，
cues.en: People can dedicate 20 years to their career and suddenly get very famous very fast

cues.zh: 在40多岁时 thanks to 互联网，或者他们可能发现自己并非刻意追求却已成名。
cues.en: in their 40s thanks to the internet, or they can find themselves famous without trying to be.

cues.zh: 你可能一觉醒来，发现自己昨晚发的推文已经被转发了45000次，
cues.en: You may wake up and find something you tweeted last night has 45,000 retweets,

cues.zh: 然后你会发现自己突然被置于不同的标准之下。
cues.en: and you will find yourself suddenly held to different standards.

cues.zh: 你不一定知道为什么这件事让你成了大人物。
cues.en: You won't necessarily know why this thing was the thing that made you a big deal.

cues.zh: 你不一定知道自己会红多久，
cues.en: You won't necessarily know how long you'll be a big deal,

cues.zh: 但突然间，关注你的人不再只是普通人了。
cues.en: but suddenly the people who follow you aren't just people anymore.

cues.zh: 他们成了观众。
cues.en: They're an audience.

cues.zh: 他们希望你成为某种样子，却未必对这个“样子”达成一致。
cues.en: And they want you to be something and they don't necessarily agree on what that something is.

cues.zh: 你希望他们怎么评判你？
cues.en: How would you want them to judge you?

cues.zh: 关于Phil Fish，最后两点。
cues.en: Two final points about Phil Fish.

cues.zh: 第一：Phil是个例外。
cues.en: One: Phil is an exception.

cues.zh: 他是白人、男性、中产阶级，并被默认为异性恋和顺性别。
cues.en: He is white, male, middle-class and presumed to be both straight and cisgender.

cues.zh: 如果你缺少其中一项或多项特征，就等着更早遭遇这种反扑吧。
cues.en: If you lack one or more of these traits, expect this kind of backlash sooner.

cues.zh: 对于任何社会少数群体来说，他们可以预期会遭遇菲尔·菲什级别的
cues.en: For people who are any kind of social minority, they can expect Phil Fish levels

cues.zh: 仇恨，甚至更糟，只因为任何被认定的冒犯。
cues.en: of hatred, or worse, for any perceived offense.

cues.zh: 有时所谓的冒犯仅仅是拥有任何观点。
cues.en: Sometimes the perceived offense is having any opinion at all.

cues.zh: 第二：
cues.en: Two:

cues.zh: 在《Fez》发布之前，菲尔通过Kokoromi发行了《Glee》和《Super Hypercube》。
cues.en: Prior to the release of Fez, Phil released Glee and Super Hypercube through Kokoromi.

cues.zh: 《Fez》是他的第三款独立游戏。
cues.en: Fez was his third Indie game.
